g.text: Posterior differences in pre-to-post probability change
Black intervals are 95% credible intervals. Four chains, 4,000 post-warmup draws, zero divergences.
Conversion of initially incorrect responses differs sharply by condition
Post-test accuracy conditional on the pretest response
Response transitions are not pure knowledge-state transitions because question format changed. The exploratory model was singular.
The 10-item score has weak internal consistency
The dashed line marks .70. The negative Grounding post-test estimate accompanies a strong ceiling.
How vocabulary organization changed target-word learning
